text: My daily routine is quite simple, but I follow it carefully. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a short walk. After breakfast, I begin work at nine and stay focused until lunchtime. In the afternoon, I try to exercise for about thirty minutes, either running or cycling. In the evening, I cook dinner, read a book, or watch a film with my family. I always go to bed before eleven. I believe consistency is the key to a healthy and productive life.
